items.title: 10.17 E standard qeematon ke istemalat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to topic 10.17, printed page 231.

blocks.text: Standard electrode potentials (E° values) teen kaamon mein istemal hote hain: cell mein electrons ke flow ki simt (direction) maloom karna (10.17.1), yeh dekhna ke koi redox reaction mumkin (feasible) hai ya nahi (10.17.2), aur oxidizing aur reducing agents ki taqat ka muqabla karna (10.17.3). Kitab is heading ke neeche seedha 10.17.1 shuru karti hai.

blocks.prompt: E° values ke teen istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation: 1) Bahar ke circuit mein electrons ke flow ki simt. 2) E°cell ke nishan (+ ya −) se reaction ki feasibility. 3) Species ko oxidizing ya reducing agent ke taur par taqat ke lihaz se tarteeb dena.

items: E° ke istemal: electron flow ki simt, reaction ki feasibility, oxidizing aur reducing agents ki taqat.
